correctness.rationale: The local-noise Lindblad generator is strictly stable for g>0 by a dissipative Hilbert-Schmidt form and connected adjacency; hence the integrated trace mean exists. Under the trap stabilizer its Hermitian invariant space has exactly 18 real coordinates. The generator is affine in the number of other triangles by single-index adjacency sums. Exact symbolic rational inversion proves the stated scaling profile and nonnegative polynomial coefficient certificates for both global coercive bounds; the cubic derivative has one positive root. A distinct full N²-dimensional complex-Liouvillian implementation agrees at 15 cases; numerical checks corroborate, not replace the structural all-m proof. Reproduction: verify_friendship.py.

value.rationale: Triangle motifs joined by a common hub form a natural controlled test bed for interference release versus quantum-Zeno slowing. The exact finite generator supports the sharp all-noise optimal rate 1.226929...sqrt(m) and capture-time coefficient 1.681019...m^(3/2), quantitatively distinct from the star. Uniform global bounds are needed to establish the actual optimum, not only a trial scaling. This gives a reusable transport benchmark beyond finite enumeration or merely proving the shared exponent.
